_meta.method: Paths are the atlas leaves. Renderer flags come from the actual read sites in display/display.js and the inline copy; Designer flags come from the property editor, container geometry, animation and motion panels. Harness means an existing Node renderer test exercises the behaviour; code reading means the read site was inspected but the specific leaf was not individually harnessed.
_meta.limitations: The Node stub records style writes rather than painted pixels, so 'works' means the renderer applies the value, not that it was visually inspected in OBS.
